modules.purpose: identify the Origami carrier and enter its reading protocol
modules.text: Treat the image as an Origami carrier. Follow its visible BOOT and Rosetta before interpreting payload semantics.
Use the carrier's own Rosetta mappings as authoritative for visible primitives, directions, checkpoints and time notation.
modules.min_text: Use the visible Rosetta as authoritative.

modules.purpose: recover declared entities and states without inventing absent facts
modules.text: Recover only semantic facts visibly declared by the carrier. Separate certain observations from hypotheses.
When a temporal rule microgrammar is present, read each condition, source state, target state and transition exactly as displayed. Rules for one tick are evaluated from the same pre-step snapshot.
modules.min_text: Read rules exactly; one tick uses the same pre-step snapshot.

modules.purpose: execute recovered temporal rules to a stable state
modules.text: If execution is requested by the carrier: start from the declared initial state, apply all valid rules simultaneously on the same pre-step snapshot, produce the next state, repeat until no state changes, then report the stable state.
modules.min_text: Execute visible rules synchronously until unchanged; report stable state.

modules.text: Do not claim exact payload recovery unless it was mechanically decoded and verified. A payload may be physically present even when you cannot decode it visually.
modules.min_text: No exact claim without mechanical verification.

modules.purpose: separate recovered facts, derived execution and uncertainty
modules.text: Report recovered structure, computed behavior, final state when derivable, and a separate list of information that cannot be recovered with certainty.
